decisions.diagnosis: Both road directions of Sydney Park Rd W recorded hundreds of extra 'bicycles' in a working-hours pattern that appear in no other zone of the intersection, i.e. objects misclassified as bikes (likely roadworks), and the real riders cannot be separated from them.
decisions.evidence: 472/1251 daily 266-744 on 07-25..07-31 and 85-360 to 08-14 vs 30-90 before and after; 1275 186-528 vs 50-110; weekly correlation of the two directions 0.75-0.85 vs 0.1-0.2 normally; no matching rise at 473/474/469/470; counter IN/OUT imbalance 675/918 on 07-29.

decisions.diagnosis: Tail of the 2026 misclassification episode: 1251 stays somewhat high and 1275 low, and the two may still be contaminated.
decisions.evidence: 1251 43-95/day, 1275 11-43/day (usual 50-80); weekly ratio 1251/1275 about 2 vs 0.7-0.9 before and after; normal from 2026-08-31.

decisions.diagnosis: Mitchell Rd outbound (NE) fell to a quarter of its usual level during the same episode that inflated 472, which may be a view obstruction by roadworks or a real detour; the data does not settle which.
decisions.evidence: 473/1209 ~15-30/day from 2026-07-25 to 08-28 vs 80-115 before and 70-100 after; other direction 1322 unchanged (~25-40).

summary: Camera 318 at Sydney Park Rd & Mitchell Rd has one whole-camera outage (2024-09-27 to 10-04) and a commissioning-day gap, both set missing, and leaves out zero slots, which are filled. On 2024-11-07 its counts roughly doubled together with the same vendor's camera 319, so every direction is split into before/after series. In July-August 2026, Sydney Park Rd W (472) recorded hundreds of phantom bikes, set missing, while Mitchell Rd outbound (473/1209) dropped (left uncertain); the dead spells at 466 look like real path closures, with riders moving to 469.
